column2: 88. The Zones SL shall provide for expeditious resolution
of  labour  disputes  and  disputes  between  investors  and
workers  employed  within  investment  zones.  Mechanisms
such  as  alternate  dispute  resolution  methods  or  any  other
means of dispute resolution may be prescribed by way of
89.  Zones  SL  may  recommend  to  the  Economic
Commission, the administrative incentives and exemption
from laws specified in the Schedule to this Part to be granted
to investors within the investment zones, from time to time.
